name: scratchpad
description: Write out text for the task's record, such as a drafted email, message or document. Nothing is sent or saved anywhere. The text comes back as the tool's result, so the final answer can give it to the user.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: The complete text, written out in full.

arguments_prompt: text (required): the complete text, written out in full and word for word as the user should read it.

metadata.planner_description: Write out a draft or other text for the user. Nothing is sent or saved; the text reaches the final answer.
